svg.aria-label: Pass count on the ten DABstep gold tasks by agent version, across two loops. Supervised loop, optimiser shown the gold failures: v0, NVIDIA's prompt on Haiku 4.5, passed 4 of 10; v1 passed 8 of 10 but broke task 1871, p 0.109 on a one-sided exact McNemar test, held; v2 passed 9 of 10 with five fixed and none broken, p 0.031, promoted. Unsupervised loop, optimiser shown gold-free family cards from a probe of the 450: v3 improved every gold-free signal but passed 7 of 10, breaking tasks 49 and 1681, and gate A held it. Every version is compared against the champion at the time.
svg.title: Two loops: the supervised one promoted v2; the unsupervised one held v3 on the gold anchor

g.title: gridlines at 5 and 10 passes; the axis is 0
supervised loop · cycles 1–3 · the optimiser reads every failed dev trace with its gold, writes agents/v(N+1)/, and a one-sided exact McNemar test on the paired flips decides

unsupervised loop · cycles 4–5 · the champion is probed on 47 of the 450 unscored, two passes; gold-free signals and twelve family cards go to the optimiser; gate A promotes only if no dev task broke and the paired signals improved
v0 · 4 of 10 · NVIDIA's nine-line inference prompt on claude-haiku-4-5 with a 57-line helper · 1 of 3 easy, 3 of 7 hard · $0.754, 90 turns · the champion cycles 1 and 3 were measured against
v1 · 8 of 10 · cycle 1: one Sonnet session, 40 turns, 3.85 M input tokens, four prompt rules and thirteen helper functions · fixed 49, 70, 1273, 1681, 1753 · broke 1871 · p 0.109 · held

v2 · 9 of 10 · cycle 3: 27 turns, 2.05 M input tokens, kept v1's helper, removed best_matching_fee, added fee_total_for_rule and total_fees_paid · the same five fixed, nothing broken · p 0.031 · promoted, champion · 2697 still fails

v3 · 7 of 10 · cycle 5, unsupervised: 29 turns, 2.31 M input tokens, a routing table with one row per family and three new helpers · every gold-free signal improved on the paired probe · but 49 answered in prose instead of the letter, and 1681 returned a different fee-id list · gate A held it
